LESSON: PROTOCOLS IN JAIN DHARMA AARTI AND MANGAL DIVO,

Grade: Grade 8
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Religious Practices
Topic 4.2: Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo,
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 13

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo,, part of Religious Practices in Grade 8 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to learn about the Aarti, Mangal Divo and its significance?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. visit the Derasar, accompanied by parents/guardians, to record with digital devices/assistive technology and present in class the relevance of the protocols, their components and significance,

2. perform the protocols at the end of their presentation, individually or with peers,

3. write a detailed report on findings from visits to places of worship that include the attitudinal disposition one has while performing the religious practices,

4. invite resource person to give a talk on the mandatory protocols of the religious practices

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. visit the Derasar, accompanied by parents/guardians, to record with digital devices/assistive technology and present in class the relevance of the protocols, their components and significance,
2. perform the protocols at the end of their presentation, individually or with peers,
3. write a detailed report on findings from visits to places of worship that include the attitudinal disposition one has while performing the religious practices,
4. invite resource person to give a talk on the mandatory protocols of the religious practices

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Protocols in Jain Dharma Aarti and Mangal Divo, together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Self-efficacy: The learner enhances self-awareness and planning skills while creating a skit and dramatising the do’s and

don’ts of religious etiquette observed at the Derasar.

● Critical thinking: The learner enhances active listening and communication skills when writing a detailed report and

presenting in class.

Values:
Respect: The learner acquires open mindedness when creating a skit and dramatising the do’s and don’ts of religious etiquette

observed at the Derasar.

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCI’s):

● Citizenship: The learner enhances citizenship when writing a detailed report and presenting it with the recording: on their

findings from their visit to the Derasar that includes their own attitudes with the people they encounter.

● Financial literacy: The learner applies financial literacy skills when observing how the Aarti and Mangal Divo rituals are

planned and executed.

Link to other subjects:

The learner is able to relate to the skills of creating a skit and dramatising the dos and don’ts of religious etiquette observed at

the Derasar, and perform the Aarti and Mangal Divo at the end of their presentation to the creative skills learnt in Creative Arts

and Sports.
